zh-CN.title: Agent 评测工作台
zh-CN.description: 查看三个固定用例，执行离线流程演示或真实 Agent 实验，逐条检查输出和规则评分，导出实验报告。

usage.title: 先确认固定用例
usage.description: 从侧边栏打开 Agent 评测，查看每条输入、参考答案和 JSON 判分标准。参考答案只用于评分。

usage.title: 运行并复核结果
usage.description: 先运行离线演示验证流程，再按需运行真实 Agent。查看执行状态、实际输出、逐项评分与原始会话，并下载 JSON 报告。

en-US.title: Agent Evaluation Workbench
en-US.description: Inspect three fixed cases, run deterministic offline demonstrations or real Agent experiments, review rule-based grades and export reports.

usage.title: Inspect the cases
usage.description: Open Agent Evaluation from the sidebar to inspect each prompt, reference answer and JSON grading rule. References are used only by the grader.

usage.title: Run and review an experiment
usage.description: Run an offline demonstration first, then explicitly start a real Agent experiment. Inspect outputs, checks and source conversations, and download a JSON report.
